column2: Twinkle Sprinkle publishes Guide to the Cities of the World

The Brodfeldian scholar Twinkle Sprinkle has recently published the world's first comprehensive guide to its major cities and countries. The result of years of travel and research, the book chronicles 103 major locations on all three continents, combining personal accounts with local history and legend. The guide has become a sensation with the public overnight, with thousands being sold in Griffonia and Equestria alone, and the book already being translated for a variety of languages. Its jubilant author has already promised a second edition to be coming soon, with updated info and additional entries.
The world becomes a little bit smaller
